top_signals.title: Tax-Slashing ‘Holy Grail’ Popularized by AQR Dealt IRS Warning
top_signals.summary: A strategy popularized by AQR Capital Management, the world’s largest hedge fund, to help wealthy people slash their taxes on ordinary income is facing the most concrete sign yet that US authorities are preparing to clamp down.

top_signals.title: UK Should Relax Accounting Rules to Boost Investment, Paper Says
top_signals.summary: Britain is wasting an opportunity to invest billions of pounds in infrastructure by sticking to rigid national accounting rules that prevent arms-length government bodies from borrowing on their own account, the Common Wealth think tank said.
